causal_hypotheses.claim: Progressive phase-one reopening will produce observable net XRP withdrawals from Binance-controlled wallets.
support: Official announcement includes XRP in phase one.
disconfirming_or_missing: Status page still exposes no per-asset row.
No successful customer withdrawal observed.
Internal reshuffling and custody consolidation remain alternatives.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Withdrawn XRP will be sold and create net sell pressure.
disconfirming_or_missing: Self-custody, exchange-to-exchange, institutional custody and OTC routes are alternatives.
No trade evidence.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Ripple's escrow release caused or was coordinated with Binance withdrawal reopening.
support: Both events occur on November 1.
disconfirming_or_missing: No shared transaction, counterparty or flow evidence.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Scheduled GitHub workflows can create/close/assign issues or commit metrics without an explicit per-run human confirmation.
support: auto-resolve-issues has schedule and issues:write; autonomous-resolver has hourly schedule and issues/pull-requests write; daily-digest and self-schedule create issues on schedules; gumroad-metrics commits aggregate metrics to main.
disconfirming_or_missing: No evidence these workflows ran during this research run; actual schedule history not exhaustively inspected.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Barrot Autonomous Resolver is actively collaborating with Copilot.
support: Workflow reads vars.COPILOT_ASSIGNEE and will assign issues/PRs if configured.
disconfirming_or_missing: Variable value not inspected; no authentication or handoff test; no Copilot completion evidence.

causal_hypotheses.claim: SBI Group is building a multi-rail digital-finance network in which XRP is one of several instruments rather than the exclusive settlement rail.
support: SBI's Ripple and Evernorth relationships.
SBI's Circle investment/JV and USDC distribution relationship.
JPYSC, SMFG, BlackRock, Startale and Open Standard/OUSD initiatives.
SBI XRP rewards, remittance and XRPL PoC programs.
disconfirming_or_missing: No integrated production flow connecting XRP with JPYSC, OUSD or the BlackRock tokenized MMF has been established.
No disclosed capital-allocation mandate showing coordinated cross-entity XRP strategy.

causal_hypotheses.claim: JPYSC, USDC and RLUSD may substitute for some XRP bridge-asset use in selected institutional payment or collateral workflows.
support: SBI's expanding stablecoin and tokenized-asset partnerships.
Circle and Ripple stablecoin distribution on overlapping infrastructure.
disconfirming_or_missing: SBI Remit continues to describe XRP as a bridge asset in certain corridors.
No corridor-level before/after volumes or replacement evidence.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Coinbase has strong economic incentives to distribute USDC while maintaining a multi-issuer stablecoin strategy that includes RLUSD.
support: Circle H1 distribution costs to Coinbase of $655.3M.
Coinbase Q3 stablecoin revenue and USDC rewards disclosures.
Coinbase's RLUSD distribution arrangement.
disconfirming_or_missing: Coinbase Q3 filing does not separately disclose XRP collateral or XRP-specific stablecoin revenue.
Circle distribution costs do not equal Coinbase net profit.

causal_hypotheses.claim: The reported RLUSD XRPL supply decline reflects a material chain-specific contraction, but its cause is not established.
support: DefiLlama reports 7d -24.55% total XRPL stablecoins and 88.55% RLUSD dominance.
stables.cool reports RLUSD near $707.4M and USDC near $4.8M.
disconfirming_or_missing: Provider total stablecoin universes differ.
No complete mint/burn/bridge/transfer reconciliation was performed.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Daily ETF flow differences primarily reflect fund-universe and measurement differences rather than a single contradictory capital event.
support: XRP Insights excludes GXRP flows and includes BITW; Maketo tracks five different tickers.
ChainCatcher/SoSoValue October 29 inflow near $8.43M aligns with Maketo +$8.4M and XRP Insights +6.4M XRP.
disconfirming_or_missing: Issuer-level share creation/redemption and XRP inventory files still need row-by-row reconciliation.

causal_hypotheses.claim: The announced Binance phase-one window may lead to measurable XRP withdrawals, but actual XRP availability is not verified.
support: Official announcement includes XRP and a 06:00-09:00 UTC progressive window.
disconfirming_or_missing: Status page last-updated text is stale and table shows No Data.
No successful customer XRP withdrawal transaction observed.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Progressive reopening may produce measurable Binance XRP custody outflows, but the size and market effect are unknown.
support: Official Binance announcement lists XRP in phase one.
disconfirming_or_missing: Status page has no per-asset record; no successful withdrawal observed; custody outflow does not necessarily imply sale.

causal_hypotheses.claim: The November 1 1B XRP gross release could increase XRP outside escrow, but it does not establish tradable supply or sell pressure.
support: XRP Insights reports 1B released and zero re-escrow by ledger 108038942.
disconfirming_or_missing: Destination fields, custody control, subsequent transfers, OTC transactions and later EscrowCreate events remain unknown.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Main-branch workflow integrity risk persists until the fresh-main safety proposal is approved and merged.
support: Main retains write-capable scheduled workflows and a manual merge queue; PR #1449 passed exact-head CI and gate.
disconfirming_or_missing: No approved merge has occurred; CI validates the proposal only.

exclusions: Do not infer actual XRP withdrawal availability from the announced window or empty status page.
Do not infer a sale from a withdrawal or wallet movement.
Do not infer XRP-specific purchases from Binance's aggregate recovery claim.
Do not infer causality between Ripple escrow and Binance withdrawals.
Do not treat scheduled issue assignment as verified Copilot collaboration.
Do not treat PR CI as main remediation before explicit approval and merge.
Do not infer a no-job push event on a workflow_dispatch-only workflow is a failed approval execution.
unknowns: Current Binance XRP withdrawal activation and first successful customer withdrawal.
Cause and transaction path of RLUSD XRPL supply contraction.
Coinbase asset-specific XRP collateral balances, if any.
Production JPYSC/OUSD interoperability and any XRP routing.
Actual XRP disposition after November 1 escrow execution.
Binance XRP withdrawal success and asset-specific status during phase one.
Actual XRP-specific amount and venue used for Binance incident replenishment.
Destination and subsequent disposition of the November 1 escrow release after ledger 108038942.
Current attacker-wallet balance and any post-October 31 outflows.
Whether PR #1449 will receive explicit approval and be merged.
disconfirming_evidence: Coinbase Q3 10-Q has no XRP text hit and no separately disclosed XRP collateral amount.
SBI's JPYSC, BlackRock/Startale and SMFG announcements do not name Ripple or XRP.
XRPL USDC supply is only about 4.8-5.0M in the cited trackers, far below RLUSD supply.
Binance status page at 06:53:22 AM displayed no records, so the announcement alone cannot establish live XRP withdrawal availability.
The 100% XRP backing statement is company-reported and does not prove XRP-specific purchases or stolen-XRP recovery.
PR #1449 remains draft and unmerged; no main remediation is active.
